observed_depth_fallback.source_supported_interpretation: The optional wind depth route declined one attempt and continued into the original full renderer. This counter alone does not mean a dropped draw or arithmetic mismatch.
observed_depth_fallback.cause_inference: Existing pool saturation is consistent with the refusal and affects both arms, but no per-reason counter identifies this particular attempt. Allocation refusal, upload refusal or another optional preparation failure cannot be excluded from these logs.
observed_depth_fallback.verification_limitation: Per-draw verification was disabled during live timing. Zero mismatch counters are not a new equivalence proof; separate native/frozen-fidelity checks establish that contract.

policy_correction.limitation: An optional-path resource fallback is distinct from a correctness mismatch. The exact allocation/upload/refusal cause of this one event is not uniquely established; per-draw verification was disabled during timing.

remaining_pool_cache_pressure.scope: Eight final-live-v5 runs: TD and RA, reference/candidate/candidate/reference. Original logs and timing summary are unchanged.

method.snapshots: First dump is cumulative after warmup; second dump is cumulative after measurement. Measured deltas are second minus first.
method.warm_delta_limitation: There is no counter dump before warmup. First-dump counters include startup, scripted frames and warmup; they are not a warm-only delta.
method.normalization: Selected measured counter deltas divided by FRAMEPROF frames strictly between measure begin/end. These are counts per reported measured frame, not measured milliseconds.
method.gauge_fields: active_stores/reserved_stores/reserved_bytes, static lru/entry/byte counts and unique cache/scratch sizes are gauges; they are preserved at both boundaries rather than treated as monotonic counts.
method.fallback_meaning: MESHPOOL counts declined store/reuse attempts (including allocation refusal), not dropped draws or failed frames. A logical draw can try the pool more than once before streaming/full-path fallback.
method.upload_counter: MESHPERF uploads count all mesh-batch uploads, including transient/stream fallback; they are shown beside static-cache counters for context and are not static-only uploads.

findings.ra_pool_pressure: All four RA warm-end snapshots have 2048 active/reserved stores and 6082 cumulative fallback attempts. Measured pool fallback deltas are 333486, 302424, 351085, 315348 in ABBA order. All four trim 2034 stores during measurement.
findings.td_pool_pressure: All four TD runs retain 325 stores with 172 active at both dumps and have zero measured pool fallbacks/trims.
findings.static_cache_churn: RA ends at 8192 static entries in both arms, with measured evictions 6847, 974, 6896, 6875. TD also has persistent-cache turnover (40049,44046,44046,42344 measured evictions); these counters alone do not quantify its time cost or prove a bug.
findings.new_unique_cache: Candidate unique cache has 26 RA builds / 22 TD builds during startup/warmup, zero measured builds/evictions/fallbacks, and repeated hits. No evidence that new unique cache is causing the old pool/cache pressure.

single_depth_fallback.source_supported_interpretation: The optional wind depth route declined one attempt and continued into the original full renderer. This counter alone does not mean a dropped draw or arithmetic mismatch.
single_depth_fallback.cause_inference: Existing pool saturation is consistent with the refusal and affects both arms, but no per-reason counter identifies this particular attempt. Allocation refusal, upload refusal or another optional preparation failure cannot be excluded from these logs.
single_depth_fallback.verification_limitation: Per-draw verification was disabled during live timing. Zero mismatch counters are not a new equivalence proof; separate native/frozen-fidelity checks establish that contract.

findings.parser_policy: Zero-fallback is stricter than the documented bounded renderer contract. Live validation should retain/report resource fallbacks and require used routes, zero reported mismatches, script completion and caps. A strict no-fallback assertion may remain a separate controlled-fixture expectation.
findings.remaining_cost: The existing RA pool saturation and persistent-cache turnover remain performance costs to investigate; no allocation limits, algorithms or runtime settings were changed by this audit.

limitations: No games, compilers, benchmark reruns, source edits or raw-log edits were performed.
Live verification is disabled to avoid its timing cost; zero reported mismatches is not fresh per-draw pixel equivalence proof.
The counter identifies optional-path fallback, not its exact allocation/upload cause or duration.
Live simulation progress, asset first use, present waits and shared-host load remain in these wall-clock measurements.
This is a parser reanalysis receipt; host-isolation, asset/end-integrity and rendering equivalence require their separate evidence.
Approximate screenshot reproduction with one wide camera per game and two measured runs per arm; not an all-map or sustained-FPS guarantee.
Host isolation is not established: macOS ps comm truncation made the original process filter unreliable. These are observed shared-host measurements; retain run ranges.
No run or frame was removed and no rerun was selected to replace the fallback case.

hidden_installed_smoke.scope: Hidden checks from actual Dock and canonical installed executables, including TD/RA normal, off, allocation-refusal and scratch-refusal prepared-wind routes. Two TD app checks cover scene launch; eleven cases also expose wind/picking telemetry.

independent_audit.notes: Read-only independent audit; no builds, games, installation changes or source mutations. Hidden installed smoke is tracked separately by parent.
